references.text: The warning against mixing with the remaining nations and following their gods. The Lord warns of the consequences of having fellowship with pagan peoples.
The prohibition against mentioning the names of other gods and swearing by them. This emphasizes the requirement for complete loyalty to the Lord.
Moses' command not to make a covenant with the nations in Canaan or marry them, to avoid idolatry.
The warning against following the religious customs of the pagan peoples and asking after their gods.
The prohibition against learning to do according to the detestable practices of the nations that lived in the land.
The fulfillment of the warning: Israel's next generation abandoned the Lord and served Baal and other gods.
The psalmist's promise not to take the names of foreign gods upon his lips.
The Lord's promise to remove the name of the Baals from Israel's mouth.
